limitations: Five post-measurement, same-author source-admission probes. No retrieval, packing, or independent judgment.

documents.name: maintenance.md
documents.text: Technicians must inspect the intake filters and replace worn seals after calibration.

documents.name: seal-storage.md
documents.text: Staff must label spare seals before storing them.

documents.name: gate-drill.md
documents.text: During a fire drill, gatekeepers must close the loading gate after the announcement.

documents.name: gate-arrival.md
documents.text: Gatekeepers must close the loading gate after a forklift enters.

documents.name: award-log.md
documents.text: Coordinators must record award nominations in the shared register.

documents.name: award-display.md
documents.text: Coordinators may display award nominations after approval.
